Claim 1 (Currently amended): A composite stiffener, comprising: a filler disposed in and substantially filling the void; at least one layer of composite fabric on each of the members in the area of the filler; and, a layer of adhesive surrounding the filler and joining the filler to the composite fabric, wherein the filler is a reinforcing member that is distinct from the composite fabric.

Claim 5 (Currently amended): The composite stiffener of claim 1, wherein the layer of adhesive and the at least one layer of composite fabric extend beyond the radius areas and into the interfacial regions between the members.

Claim 7 (Currently amended): A composite stiffener, comprising: a pair of composite channels joined together, each of the channels including a web, flanges extending from the web, and radius areas between the web and each of the flanges; a base extending transverse to the web and joined to each of the flanges, the radius areas of the channels and the base forming at least one radius filler zone; a reinforcing member filling the radius filler zone; a layer of composite fabric covering the radius areas of the channels and the base; and, a layer of adhesive surrounding the filler and joining the filler to the composite fabric layer, wherein the reinforcing member is distinct from the composite fabric.

Claim 11 (Currently amended): The composite stiffener of claim 7, wherein the filler is one of: a formed unidirectional composite tape, a composite laminate, a hybrid tape-fabric member, and a titanium member, and wherein the filler is distinct from the composite fabric layer.

Claim 13 (Currently amended): The composite stiffener of claim 7, wherein the layer of adhesive includes a sheet of structural adhesive wrapped around the filler, and the adhesive extends beyond the radius filler zone into interfacial layers between the channels and between the base and each of the flanges.

Claim 25 (Currently amended): A composite stiffener for aircraft applications, comprising: an I-section structure formed of laminated composite flanges on each end of the web, the structure including a radius area between the web and the flanges and a cap being joined to the first set of the flanges and the base being joined to the second set of flanges, the cap and the base each intersecting the web in the radius areas to define a radius filler zone; a reinforcing filler in the radius filler zone that is distinct from the composite fabric; and a layer of adhesive joining the filler to the composite fabric in the radius filler zone.
